), shares AS (
  SELECT p.iso_id,
         100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code IN ('wind','solar') THEN g.generation_mw ELSE 0 END)
           / NULLIF(SUM(g.generation_mw), 0) AS renewable_share_pct
  FROM peak_hours p
  JOIN core.fact_generation_hourly g
    ON g.iso_id = p.iso_id AND g.interval_start_utc = p.interval_start_utc
  JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
  GROUP BY p.iso_id
)
SELECT (MAX(CASE WHEN s.iso_id = 1 THEN s.renewable_share_pct END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN s.iso_id = 2 THEN s.renewable_share_pct END)) AS answer
FROM shares s

WITH iso_map AS (
  SELECT iso_id, iso_code
  FROM core.dim_iso
  WHERE iso_code IN ('CAISO', 'ERCOT')

  SELECT i.iso_code, b.iso_id, b.interval_start_utc, b.demand_mw, b.net_generation_mw,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.iso_code ORDER BY b.demand_mw DESC, b.interval_start_utc ASC) AS rn
  FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
  JOIN iso_map i ON b.iso_id = i.iso_id
  WHERE CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'

  SELECT p.iso_code, p.interval_start_utc,
         SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code IN ('wind', 'solar') THEN g.generation_mw ELSE 0 END) AS wind_solar_mw
  FROM peak p
  JOIN core.fact_generation_5min g
    ON g.iso_id = p.iso_id AND g.interval_start_utc >= p.interval_start_utc

  JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
  WHERE p.rn = 1
  GROUP BY p.iso_code, p.interval_start_utc
)
